text: The clinic is clean and the service is excellent. This was my first time here for root canal treatment. The doctor explained everything in detail and gave great advice. I was very impressed.

I have never been so satisfied with dental work, staff, service and orderliness in my life. !!! I still try to enjoy smiling, and not talk with my mouth closed? Still colored by my anger over previous dental work, from Denmark Copenhagen, Vesterbro, which I have previously paid a small fortune, far too loyal, and given the opportunity to correct dental work and sloppy work on a front tooth that is built up in plastic, and another dentist in Denmark almost drilled into pieces to build up in plastic so that it looks like a cartoon tooth to me? Am for hell, yes I am resoundingly happy to be sorted for now, I got a little advice on the way, and look forward to when the next trip is booked and paid for, and then get some new times made for the next stages of dental work. A big resounding thousand thousand thank you from here, a world of difference, and deeply grateful!!! Kind regards Donpaw
